en.text: Holliday brought them right to us.
Abrams has the heart of a warrior…
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
The guardian will deal with them.
They took out the Chess Guy!
Paradox put them right where we want them.
They took out the Test Pilot!
I've never seen power like that before…
So that's what a Sandman can do.
Watching her work is like poetry.
Haze was looking out for me…
You were born for this, Infernus.
You're living up to your potential, Infernus.
It's an honor to fight alongside my brother.
I get why he's a big deal.
They took out the Rat King!
He didn't waste a single movement.
So this is what relaxing feels like.
He didn't falter for a moment.
Warden fights like a man possessed.
I can't forget to train my powers.
I need to upgrade my abilities.
I need to be careful, I'm all alone.
Perhaps I was a little too confident…
I almost got caught, I need to be more careful…
Lucky to get away when I did…
We need to keep the momentum going.
They don't have a chance in hell.
I got you where I want you…
I can still finish them off…
Takes a lot more than that…
Only one of us is dying today…
I have to make this count.
You thought you were on top of the world, didn't you?
She'll come back eventually, and then I'll finish what I started.
Never stand still in a fight…
You really are making this easy for me, Bebop.
Oh just stand there and die.
You never should have tried to duel me, Paradox.
That was never going to be enough, Paradox!
Look out for the black hole.
I'll take these out all day…
How many of these damn things does she have?
Be careful they have the Rejuv!
Damn it, they have the Rejuvenator.
Geist can swap you, be careful.
Don't get too close to Geist.
That's what you get for running.
You can't hide from me, Vindicta.
And where did you think you were going, Kelvin?
At least you made me work for it, Kelvin.
You're not on my level, Lash.
I never thought the Savior of Spanish Harlem would be such a coward.
I'll be here all day, Ivy!
Where the hell did they go?
Quit hiding, come out and face me!
I knew you were going to try that.
and they thought they could stop me…
I can't afford to get cocky, the ritual is far from over.
That was their best? How sad.
I'm beginning to see how the rest of the day is going to go…
I won't rest until we win…
This is but one of many who will fall.
She didn't live up to family name.
Her grandfather must be so disappointed in her.
He forgot where he came from.
I hate to do that to a fellow Ixian.
Why aren't you standing with me, Brother?!
I take no joy in cutting down one of my own.
He was a titan of a man… a shame he made bad life choices.
I'm too fast for you, Bebop.
I'm not some drunk pit fighter, Bebop, I'm a real talent.
I don't see why Lash had trouble stopping him…
What chance did a machine have against me…
You seem like a good person, Paige, I'm sorry.
I feel like I was fighting a primary school teacher.
Paige isn't a threat to us.
We don't need to worry about Paige.
I'm not losing to a glorified librarian.
Paradox's antics have come to an end.
She thought she was untouchable… she was wrong.
Paradox, you are all mystique, no talent.
You're nothing more than a vandal that fancies herself a revolutionary.
Well, I'll say this: the man had decorum.
I took care of the Doorman
Your tricks are just a novelty, Doorman, they'll never be enough to win.
I don't care if he tried to kill me, The Baroness still has the best brunch in Manhattan.
I tipped the man last weekend, and he tries to kill me? No class.
You should have stuck with human prey, Drifter.
I'm not afraid of you, Drifter.
I'm not your victim, Drifter… I'm your executioner.
He thought he was in control, didn't he…
You deal in theoreticals, Professor, but my dominance is reality.
I'm sure he makes a better teacher than he does a fighter.
Go back to the petting zoo or wherever you crawled out of…
I don't know what that thing was, but it's dead.
I know better than to be deceived by appearances.
It doesn't matter how cute it looked, it was a threat.
A pity you're not on my side, McGinnis, my father would be a fan.
A brilliant mind… a mediocre combatant.
You can't rely on technology to do the work for you, McGinnis.
I put him out of his misery…
Don't try getting back up, Victor.
I won't be one of your victims, Lady Geist.
Oathkeeper will die with you, Geist.
She got what was coming to her.
There are no shortcuts to power, Seven.
It was a privilege to stop someone like him.
I'm not scared of you, Seven.
I won't be intimidated by humans with delusions of grandeur.
I'm not running from you, Seven. I'm running through you.
I'm more dangerous than I thought.
That the best you got, Haze?
She'll be back and I'll need to be ready.
You have tools at your disposal but you still don't know how to use them…
Only a coward kills a man at a distance.
You're not picking me off, Vindicta.
I'm not a dilettante that’s going to stand around to get shot, Vindicta.
You can do better than that, Infernus.
Have some self-respect, Infernus… stop being a human's hired help.
Your parents should have taught you about your culture.
Under proper tutelage you could have been somebody, Infernus.
You have so much power and you waste it peddling drinks in a pool hall.
I've read stories about you, Kelvin. You fell a little short of the legend.
Not all adventures have a happy ending, Kelvin.
No one cheats death forever, Kelvin.
I put Kelvin in the ground.
Perhaps you should have stayed underground where you belong.
Krill, you pretend to be a man of culture but you're just a crook.
You couldn't even beat a high school kid, Lash… how sad.
This has got to be humiliating for you, doesn't it?
Lash. You're not the best. I am.
I could take your stupid bear pit title from you any day I want.
Ego wilts in the face of real talent.
Parlor tricks were never going to be enough.
I won't suffer the indignity of being turned into a rabbit.
I'm not worried about someone who's claim to fame involves silk scarves.
My father sends his regards to ambassador Nashala.
This isn't how I was hoping I would meet the ambassador, apologies.
This isn't how I was hoping I would meet the Ambassador. Apologies.
He seemed like a decent guy.
Her reputation seems to be overblown.
You're not used to fighting someone with talent, are you, Calico?
Stay away from my family, Calico.
It was a mistake taking this contract, Calico.
It's a shame you stood against me, Graves.
Not all Blackmore students are created equal.
She was a decent lab partner.
I sent him to his son.
I gave him the death he wanted.
You're a good man Grey Talon, I'm sorry.
It's an honor to fight someone of your pedigree, Grey Talon.
I won't be hunted like some pathetic vampire.
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Father.
You belong in a trash heap, Billy.
It's easy to rage against the elite when you have nothing of substance to offer, Billy.
Billy… no one will miss you.
I couldn't shut him up fast enough…
I thought he would be more dangerous.
He knows how to use a knife, I'll give him that.
I would think the Baxter Society could afford better teachers.
I don't respect anyone who runs from their obligations.
Your father is a great man, Pocket… it's a shame you fell so short.
Should have hid in that case for longer.
You could have had the world at your fingertips, Pocket, and you pissed it all away.
You can change your name, but you can't change who you are, Pocket.
You're a noble woman, Ivy, I'm sure we'll meet again.
She fights with emotion… probably why she lost.
Who else wants to fall to my blade?
The Savior of Spanish Harlem herself couldn’t stop me
No way she's a real unicorn.
Go back to working children's birthday parties.
The unicorn isn't a problem anymore.
You always had too high an opinion of yourself, Mina.
You're not half as good as you think you are, Mina.
No love for your alma mater, Mina?
She was a blight on society.
I did this city a favor.
The Deep's issues matter little to Ixia.
You never had a chance against me, Viscous.
The Cube only delays the inevitable.
You trained your whole life, Warden, and still you fail. How sad.
You were a worthy opponent, Warden.
The man had discipline and conviction… it's a shame he didn't fight for us.
I just killed a werewolf. You're welcome.
My father would have turned her into a cloak…
Silver was all emotion, no skill.
You pray on people's vices, Wraith - I can't respect that.
You crave a legitimacy you will never earn, Wraith… because at the end of the day you're just a goon with a gun.
Not all swordsmen are created equal.
And here I was thinking Yamato would be a challenge.
Guys, you can't stop me… I'm a generational talent.
Face it: you're outclassed and outmatched.
There's no shame in losing to me.
Of course they're dying… they're fighting me.
Will none of you rise to the challenge?
The weak always fall to the strong.
I've been training my whole life for this, you don't have a chance.
You have no idea who you're up against…
My team is counting on me - I will not falter.
My team is counting on me. I will not falter.
We need to end this once and for all…
I can't let them have all the glory…
We can't falter when we're so close to victory.
Why are you carrying a pillow?
This is no place for a child.
Are you the best at anything?
You're not getting a jacket like this, sorry.
I'm the person who's putting his life in the hands of an emotional trainwreck on a suicide mission.
Grey Talon has discipline that you could only dream about. I'm amazed you haven't accidently fired your gun already.
I'm carrying it because I'm in Macbeth, what do you think.
We win today and you will.
With the two of us working together we only lose if the sun implodes.
It's not Ixia, but it's tolerable.
I'm here because my father asked me to be, not because I want to. But only a fool doesn't make the most out of every opportunity.
I'm grateful not to be paired up with a human.
No, they're not. But they're not us either. Never forget that.
If we were in Ixia you wouldn't dare talk to me like that.
How do you think I'd fair in the Bear Pit?
Don't worry about me, Bebop - I'll be fine.
There is no way in hell you will ever be within 20 miles of my father.
There's no way in hell you'll ever be within 50 miles of where he sleeps.
I'm not interested in seeing the trinkets you've stolen from others.
Let me rephase. I'm not going anywhere with you.
He is. I'll be sure to give him your well wishes.
How do you manage to treat people with respect when they look at you with contempt?
Are you comparing yourself to royalty.
Good. Helping you should count as service hours for my civics class.
You'll find out when I use it to cut out your tongue.
It's a good school. The teachers are competent and the student body well-connected.
I have my whole life to make memories. But my prime is right now and I can't waste it.
I've heard you're a good teacher.
Most teenagers are morons. I value experience.
No. I'm proud of my father, and he's proud of me.
Then you're gonna be in the thick of it, I tend to not stay in one place for long.
The last thing that I wanna do is work for a human's company.
You're paired with a prodigy. You're welcome.
So are you idly rich, or do you actually do something of value.
You have no idea who you're talking to.
That's a curious piece of jewelry you have Lady Geist
I shouldn't be seen with someone like you.
I have a responsibility to my family.
You're the one that escaped Lost Whisper.
Just enough time to wax poetic about brushing me off?
There's no honor in stabbing someone who can't defend themselves.
I think you covered that with the "Don't expect special treatment"
I don't take orders from you.
Then I guess we better win.
Are you here for the OSIC or yourself?
I read about Salem. It sounds horrific. And impossibly human.
Your war on the Friends of Humanity is commendable, even if your tactics are less than honorable.
I'm not. But as someone who's life has been affected by political assassination I have… complicated feelings.
You know, they talk about you in Ixia.
Yes. They call you Hasha Vogali.
Infernus, I want you to know that I'm approachable. I don't expect you to address me by my formal title.
It's nice to fight alongside a fellow Ixian
Have you been here so long that you forgot where you came from?
I've heard what you can do.
You know what I mean. Why are you working as a bartender?
So they just want to abandon our culture?
You're one of humanity's bravest are you not?
This isn't about me. It's about my home.
I'm not completing the ritual for my father.
He thought it was safer for me.
The reward is worth the risk
So is the mole your servant?
Then why doesn't he speak for himself.
Look, I'm sure you could handle the town drunk in a bar fight, but in real combat, you're a middling talent.
So you're that arrogant moron that I've heard so much about.
You don’t know who I am?
Please give Nashala my father's regards.
I'm royalty. It's important to know these things.
I live in New York. It will never be my home.
Nashala is lucky to have someone like you in her employ.
Why did you leave the Baxter Society?
As a general rule he doesn't break bread with assassins
Why would I put him at risk.
Until someone hires you to kill him.
My father's already proud of me, I don't need to pull stunts so he knows I exist.
How 'bout you give me the same respect.
I notice everything. Were you sick?
Of course I care. It's hard for you fight if you have a high fever or food poisoning or whatever.
It's a cultural thing. You don't have a word in English for someone who wields the power of a governor and a general the way we do in Ixia.
I don't expect you to understand.
What happened to your grandchildren is unforgiveable.
You talk as if you know him.
I'm afraid reality is less salacious than the tabloids would have you believe.
Who's to say. He's not here.
I heard about what you did in Boston.
and the private security with arrows stuck in them?
No. I'm great now. I'm just waiting for the world to catch up with the times so I can show it.
Men like you call people like me demons, so no. I don't trust you.
Yeah I definitely don't trust you.
Follow my lead, and we'll get through this.
I know what I'm talking about.
In Ixia leaders are expected to lead, not delegate.
That's kind of you to say Billy.
Are you trying to mock me, or befriend me?
It’s a family heirloom, not something you pick up at a department store.
I use it all the time.
Don't project your problems onto me.
If I didn't I wouldn'tve asked.
I'm glad I'm paired with you and not some coward
Never confuse the desperate with the courageous.
You shouldn't have saved Spanish Harlem.
Then they should have saved themselves rather than let you do all the work.
I have better things to do with my time.
I see people still have eyes.
I met the Viscount once, fascinating man.
Who's going to replace him, you?
I think you're a little old for me.
I'm amazed you've given it any thought.
If you want to see fancy you should attend one of my father's galas.
You… have me there. I shall try to make arrangements.
Not in any course I've taken.
That probably speaks to your relevance.
I imagine different people would tell you different answers.
You're hilarious. Are you housebroken too?
Are you good at your job?
Then why can't you afford pants that aren't destroyed.
Classmate. I would never be friends with someone who was stupid enough to become indebted to you.
Course you would, he's a great man.
The first step is becoming someone worth talking to.
You don't have to worry about me, I'll earn my keep.
I don’t need advice from someone who glues a horn on their head.
That's what I know you do.
Of course I'm not. I'm better than them.
Most 18 year olds aren't about to summon an elder god.
I'd never waste my time going to the circus.
No. I'm setting myself up to enjoy it.
Don't worry about me, Yamato. I'll be fine.
After the ritual I'd love to train with you sometime… Blackmore Academy doesn’t exactly offer me a challenge.
Correct. That's why I'm asking to train with you sometime, will you help me or not?
There's a reason I'm a champion.
Look on the bright side, you lost to the best.
You were courageous. And stupid. Mostly stupid.
Bet they can't wait to tell their friends how they ran from a high school kid.
I need to pull back to a more favorable position.
You didn't honestly think that would work, right?
I saw that coming a mile away.
If they were stupid enough to leave this laying around, so be it.
I know not to pass up an opportunity.
I'll take any edge I can get.
Now's our chance to push the advantage.
I shouldn't leave those souls for them to pick up.
My father doesn't have high expectations for me, he has appropriate expectations for me. After all, when you're the best, why shouldn't you expect success?
Mark my words, I will represent Ixia in the Olympics, it's only a matter of time.
My ambitions are far higher than Blackmore Academy.
I will honor my family's name.
The Patrons are lucky to have someone like me fight for them.
Our victory is assured. Unless of course the Patron pairs me with a bunch of malcontents who refuse to pull their own weight, in which case victory depends how much extra burden I need to bare.
I see you have excellent taste.
Like my father before me, I am a picture of grace and humility.
It is an honor to lead us to victory.
My father entrusted me with this blade, and I will honor him.
The family heirloom isn't a decorative piece… I know how to use it.
I can get something at the store.
I should check out the curiosity shoppe.
I wonder what I can buy now.
Might be time to get something.
I can afford a quality relic.
I need to think about what to buy next.
What to buy, what to buy…
No point in saving more souls.
I need to go shopping when I can.
Who cares, we took the objective.
A few souls won't make the difference.
We did what we came here to do…
They can have the souls, we got what we came for.
We took down the objective, good work.
You have no idea how busy I am.
I have to plan for my trip to Ixia this summer anyway…
I can't be an Olympian if I'm dead.
I'm not stepping into a fight I'm not prepared for.
Thank you, but I prefer activities where I don't need to rely on others.
I'm afraid I won't be able to join you for the ritual.
I don't need the Patron to validate my greatness.
The sigil of my family will protect me.
A true son of Ixia knows how to defend themselves.
I can't let them trap me in a corner…
I have a few tricks up my sleeve.
I have fond memories of father teaching me this…
I won't let them pin me down.
I get to define the engagement, not them.
I can't wait to see the look on their faces.
If they want to stop me, they're going to have to work for it.
If only this was legal in fencing tournaments…
I know how to finish off an opponent.
I'll bleed them out, one strike at a time.
I'll strike when they least expect it.
My blade will dance amongst them.
I can strike them from any angle.
I'll use my speed to my advantage.
I need to rely on my cunning as well as my strength.
Deflecting their blows will be trivial.
They won't lay a filthy hand on me.
Their frustration is only going to rise.
I'll shake their confidence before I run them through.
Father always said the first step to victory begins with crushing the enemy's hope.
They will try their best, and it won't be enough.
They will learn what it means to fail.
Hard to stop an opponent you can't hit.
This was drilled into me since I was five.
Stopping their attacks is second nature to me.
I'll show them what my tutors taught me.
I will bring glory to my family's name.
I'll be sure to finish them off.
My victory will not be denied.
I'm not going to hold anything back.
I hope they made peace with their god.
The results will speak for themselves.
I have no time for second guessing or self doubt… I need to strike true and decisively.
Oh I'm just getting warmed up.
I'll take on all of you!
You really need to try harder.
What did you think was going to happen?
You actually thought that would work?
I really expected more from you.
I almost feel sorry for them.
I see you voters have finally come to your senses.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
I'm not ready for a team fight.
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Thank you all for your help.
Our victory, while expected, is satisfying none the less.
We had this battle won from the moment it began.
No need to thank me. Victory is its own reward.
I never doubted this would be the outcome.
Today's glory will not be forgotten.
You all are about to bear witness to greatness.
I am a proud son of Ixia.
I've sized up our opponents… we shouldn't be worried.
If we work together, victory will be assured.
Well… time to see what the Patron has given me to work with.
Try not to die before you're useful.
Say the word and I'll impale them.
Ready to show them what I can do.
